facts.fact: The BCEAO list of payment institutions at 31 August 2026 states that structures are licensed in the Union under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA, with licences numbered from 2025.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list names two payment institutions licensed in Mali under that Instruction: INTOUCH Mali (EP.ML.001/2025, 9 May 2025) and CAURIDOR (EP.ML.002/2025, 3 September 2025).
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
